title: RRB JE Syllabus 2026 – CBT 1 & CBT 2
vacancyDetails: CBT-1 common; CBT-2 technical + non-technical as per branch
qualification: Diploma / Degree in Engineering in relevant discipline
ageLimit: 18 to 33 years (as per JE CEN; relaxations apply)
documentsRequired: Download official syllabus PDF; keep notification for pattern updates
howToApply:
1. Open JE CEN on rrbapply.gov.in
2. Download syllabus for CBT-1 and CBT-2 (technical departments)
3. Revise basic science, maths, reasoning, GA
4. Deep-dive branch technical syllabus for CBT-2
5. Practice technical numericals
shortDescription: RRB JE Syllabus – CBT-1 (Maths, Reasoning, GA, General Science) and CBT-2 Technical Ability + Basics of Computers etc.
content:
RRB Junior Engineer exam has two CBT stages.

CBT-1 (screening)

  • Mathematics
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning
  • General Awareness
  • General Science

Objective paper with negative marking; shortlisting for CBT-2.

CBT-2

  • General Awareness
  • Physics & Chemistry
  • Basics of Computers and Applications
  • Basics of Environment and Pollution Control
  • Technical Abilities – branch specific (Civil / Electrical / Mechanical / Electronics / Printing / CMA etc.)

Technical syllabus differs by post code – follow the annexure of the official JE CEN on RRB websites.
